name: Authoritative supplied environment state
scope: Environment services; never replaced by a summary
contents: Supplied domain records under actual write contracts
boundary: No global actor read; no direct acting-worker access to hidden truth

name: Case/journey working state
contents: Goals, observed stage, obligations, unknowns and source/version links
boundary: Separate hospital/payer/CM views even when correlated by journey

name: Conversation episodes
contents: Exact observed messages, asked questions, answers, refusal and channel status
boundary: Do not merge speakers or assume a silence/translation is consent

name: Reusable job definition and assignment
scope: Approved role definition plus case-local assignment
contents: Mandate, allowed scope, specialty, organization and output contract; no patient-derived profile
boundary: Shared job definition does not retain patient memories or acquire authority from its title

name: Policy/reference knowledge
contents: Approved rules, terminology and source documents
boundary: Applicability/effective version checked; summaries remain derived

name: Approved general procedures
contents: General methods, prerequisites and tool/version assumptions
boundary: No patient-derived automatic learning or procedure/skill promotion across patients

name: Case-local episodic history
contents: This case’s observations, attempts, outcomes and uncertainty
boundary: No cross-patient recall, learned habits, summaries or patient-derived procedural transfer

name: Execution checkpoints/actions
contents: Program position, source/task version, pending actions and unknown receipts
boundary: Local checkpoint does not guarantee external exactly-once effects

name: Active model context
contents: Protected request, role, relevant evidence, recent coherent exchanges and bounded recall
boundary: Budget reserves and complete call/result units; fail explicitly if essentials cannot fit

name: Retrieval and computation caches
contents: Lexical/vector indexes, tool-result caches and provider prompt cache where available
boundary: Different invalidation/retention; cache does not create new knowledge or permission
